title: ML 1: Regression, Gradient Descent and Classification
summary: Supervised vs. unsupervised learning, linear regression, cost functions, gradient descent, feature scaling, polynomial regression, classification, logistic regression, and regularisation.

title: ML 2: Neural Networks, Multiclass Classification and Model Diagnostics
summary: Activation functions, softmax and multi-label classification, ADAM, layer types, computation graphs, bias/variance, regularisation, transfer learning, skewed data, decision trees and tree ensembles vs. neural networks.

title: ML 3: Clustering, Anomaly Detection and Recommender Systems
summary: K-means clustering, anomaly detection with Gaussian distributions, recommender systems, collaborative filtering, principal component analysis, and an introduction to reinforcement learning.

title: ML 4: Sequence Models and Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: RNNs, forward/back-propagation through time, RNN architectures, language modelling, vanishing gradients, GRUs, LSTMs, bidirectional and deep RNNs.

title: ML 5: Word Representation, Embeddings and Sentiment Classification
summary: Word representation, transfer learning with word embeddings, the embedding matrix, neural language models, GloVe, and RNNs for sentiment classification.

title: ML 6: Sequence-to-Sequence Models, Beam Search and Attention
summary: Encoder-decoder models, beam search and length normalisation, error analysis, BLEU score, the attention mechanism, speech recognition, and trigger word detection.

title: ML 7: Transformer Networks
summary: Motivation for moving beyond recurrence, self-attention, multi-head attention, and the Transformer architecture.

label: NT Intro
title: Number Theory Introduction
summary: Number sets, parity, Pythagorean triples, divisibility rules, primes and the Sieve of Eratosthenes, GCD/LCM and the Euclidean algorithm, divisor counting, linear Diophantine equations and modular arithmetic.

label: Fibonacci
title: Notes on Fibonacci Numbers
summary: The Fibonacci sequence and its identities: sums of terms, odd and even terms and squares, the addition formula by induction, divisibility, and formulas for multiples.

label: NT Lab
title: My Experimental Introduction to Number Theory
summary: Divisors and divisor counts, the division algorithm, GCD with the Euclidean and extended Euclidean algorithms, Lamé's theorem, unique factorisation, the Sieve of Eratosthenes and the Prime Number Theorem.

label: Counting
title: Notes on Set Theory and Counting
summary: Tower of Hanoi, sets and cardinality, set operations, relations and functions, counting principles, permutations, binomial and multinomial coefficients, Pascal's triangle, inclusion–exclusion, derangements and Stirling numbers.

label: Figurate
title: Figurate Numbers
summary: Polygonal and centred polygonal numbers with general and recursive formulas, a reciprocal-sum formula, polyhedral and tetrahedral numbers, and higher-dimensional triangular numbers as binomial coefficients.

label: Complex
title: Notes on Complex Numbers
summary: The imaginary unit, Cartesian arithmetic and conjugates, the Argand plane, modulus, polar and exponential forms, Euler's formula, De Moivre's theorem, nth roots and conjugate-pair roots of polynomials.

label: Music
title: Domain Research: Music and Mathematics
summary: Mathematical models of notes, waveforms and superposition, ADSR envelopes, harmonics and timbre, AM/FM/PM modulation, sampling, the Fourier transform, and generating a sine tone in Python.

label: Ad Infinitum
title: Introductory Notes on the Infinite and Ancient Greece (Ad Infinitum)
summary: Zeno's dichotomy and Achilles paradoxes, geometric series, Democritus' pyramid volume, Eudoxus' method of exhaustion, Archimedes' quadrature of the parabola and St. Vincent's geometric series.
